summary.text: Bruce Antone represents District 41 in the Florida House of Representatives. According to the House, Antone previously served in the House from 2002 to 2006 and from 2012 to 2020, and was elected again in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Antone worked as a legislative aide to State Senator Buddy Dyer in 1992-1999 and 2001-2002. The House lists Antone's residence as Orlando and an occupation of consultant.
Antone holds a degree in electrical engineering from the Tuskegee Institute and moved to Florida in 1984.
